instruction.text: Fill in the gaps to complete the sentences.

atoms.b: Pronouns are ((++short long)) words that can replace ((++nouns adjectives)).

instruction.text: Look at the sentence. Select the subject pronoun which fits best to the bolded words.

atoms.a: Angelina and her father have decided to go berry-picking together.
atoms.b: ((++They We)) have decided to go berry-picking together.

atoms.a: Betty, Laurence and Vanessa can hear me at the back of the classroom, right?
atoms.b: ((++You We)) can hear me at the back of the classroom, right?
((++She You)) just bought a pet parakeet.

instruction.text: Read the dialogue and write the correct subject pronouns.

feedback.wrong: Ask yourself: who is being addressed?

atoms.a: Have you seen Jerry and Camilla?
atoms.b: I haven’t. Have ((they)) arrived back from their bike ride yet?

atoms.a: Hey Alan. How was it at the barber’s?
atoms.b: Great! ((I)) love what my barber did with my hair.

atoms.a: Ramos is picking up olive oil from the grocery store for me.
atoms.b: Oh, that’s important. ((You)) need that for the dinner you’re preparing, right?

atoms.a: Have you all seen the latest spy film yet?
atoms.b: Not yet. ((We)) are waiting for it to be released on a streaming service.

atoms.a: Do you think our neighbours could help with moving this weekend?
atoms.b: ((They)) shouldn’t have a problem with that.

instruction.text: Select the correct statement(s) about subject pronouns.

hint.text: More than one answer can be correct.

b: ++... pronouns that usually come before the verb in a sentence.
... pronouns that come after the verb in a sentence.
